children: Iraq’s Midland Oil Company is seeking partnerships with US companies to develop gas fields in Diyala and Anbar provinces, its director general said.

Mohammed Yassin Hassan told the Iraqi News Agency (INA) on Tuesday that the Ministry of Oil would reassess partners and exploration blocks and open opportunities to qualified companies, noting that what currently exists are exploration blocks rather than proven fields,
He said work on surface facilities at the Mansuriya gas field was expected to proceed soon. The project was awarded outside the licensing rounds.

Midland Oil Company aims to establish integrated gas production and processing facilities, he said, noting that fields are numerous and geographically dispersed, and few are too small to develop independently, making integration with other fields necessary.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)

title: Iraq eyes US partnerships to develop gas fields in Diyala and Anbar
